english.meaning: in one go, not in parts

exampleSentences.english: Can’t take 30 days off all at once? I won’t let you…
exampleSentences.traditional: 唔可以一次過放三十日㗎？唔俾你…
exampleSentences.jyutping: m4 ho2 ji5 jat1 ci3 gwo3 fong3 saam1 sap6 jat6 gaa4 m4 bei2 nei5

exampleSentences.english: When are you taking your 30 days off? All at once or split up, if you could choose?
exampleSentences.traditional: 幾時吖？你啲假三十日幾時放吖？一次過放定分開放啊，如果俾你？
exampleSentences.jyutping: gei2 si4 aa1 nei5 di1 gaa3 saam1 sap6 jat6 gei2 si4 fong3 aa1 jat1 ci3 gwo3 fong3 ding6 fan1 hoi1 fong3 aa3 jyu4 gwo2 bei2 nei5
